{Sound:00:92}These raindrops are like boulders of
water to us, kid! Watch out!
If one of them hits us, it'll sting
something fierce!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Esto está plagado de bombas...
¡Ten mucho cuidado!
Con nuestro tamaño, si rozamos una,
estamos perdidos.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}These raindrops are like boulders of
water to us, kid! Watch out!
If one of them hits us, it'll sting
something fierce!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:91}Hehehe! So, what do you think,
{Player}?
{01:0A}Pretty dark and spooky, isn't it?
Makes you wanna cry, doesn't it?
{01:01}What? You're...not scared?
Well, good! Neither am I!
{Sound:00:91}So, um... Come on, let's go...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:91}Ay, ay, ay... ¿qué dices, {Player}?
¿No te da miedo esta oscuridad?
{01:0A}(?)...

{01:01}¿De verdad que no tienes miedo?
Yo tampoco, tampoco.
Lo decía por ti...
{Sound:00:91}Hala, vamos.

Beautiful! Simply beautiful, my boy!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}¡Guau, menuda catarata!
Es enorme, ¡y qué vista!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Wow! Look at the size of that waterfall!
Beautiful! Simply beautiful, my boy!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}A stone door!

So! This was what they meant by all of
that "{Color:Green}source of the flow{Color:White}" business!
Well, this waterfall certainly is the
source of all Hyrule's water.
According to {Color:Green}King Gustaf{Color:White}, the final
{Color:Red}element {Color:White}lies somewhere behind the falls.
We've dawdled long enough, {Player}!
Let's go find that element!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}¡La puerta de piedra!

Claro. El {Color:Green}origen del agua{Color:White} se refería
a este lugar... Esta catarata es sin
duda el origen del agua que llega a
Hyrule. Según lo que nos contó el {Color:Green}rey
Gustaf{Color:White}, la pista para llegar hasta el
último {Color:Red}elemento{Color:White} debería estar por
aquí... Abre bien los ojos, {Player}.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}What have we here? Some kind
of vortex?
Well, we seem to have hit a dead end...
What shall we do from here?

Parece que sólo se puede caminar
hasta aquí. ¿Cómo podemos continuar?

{01:0A}... ...

... ...

{01:0A}(!)

It's worth a shot, {Player}!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}¿Qué hace un edificio así sobre
las nubes? ¿Quién vivirá aquí?
Quizá nos pueda dar alguna pista
que nos lleve hasta el último {Color:Red}elemento{Color:White}.
Pregunta, {Player}.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}Now how do you build something
like this on top of a cloud?
Maybe someone lives inside. If so,
perhaps we could ask for the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}?
It's worth a shot, {Player}!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}So this perfectly normal-looking stone
was another {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White} to the Minish world!
There may be other {Color:Blue}rock portals{Color:White}. Keep
your eyes peeled, boy...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}Así que esta {Color:Blue}roca{Color:White} que no parece
nada especial a primera vista es
la {Color:Blue}entrada{Color:White}... Claro, las entradas
no sólo tienen forma de tocones...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}So this perfectly normal-looking stone
was another {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White} to the Minish world!
There may be other {Color:Blue}rock portals{Color:White}. Keep
your eyes peeled, boy...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}That's right! Even some human objects
are {Color:Blue}portals{Color:White} to the Minish world!
Those Minish may not look like much,
but they are quite crafty!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}Hasta estas herramientas de hombres
pueden ser {Color:Blue}entradas{Color:White} secretas...
Los {Color:Green}minish{Color:White} pensaron mucho para que
los hombres no se diesen cuenta.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}That's right! Even some human objects
are {Color:Blue}portals{Color:White} to the Minish world!
Those Minish may not look like much,
but they are quite crafty!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}What? ...What is this?
What's happened here!?
They've been turned to stone! All of
them! The minister...and the guards!
Everyone in the castle, all just
like {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}...
This can only be the work of that evil
Vaati! What cruelty. {Player}!
We must use the power of the sacred
{Color:Red}Four Sword{Color:White} to {Color:Blue}undo this evil{Color:White}!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}¡Es...! ¡No puede ser!

¡Es de piedra! ¡El secretario real
también! ¡Y los soldados!
¡Todos están convertidos en piedra
como la {Color:Green}princesa Zelda{Color:White}!
¡No hay duda de que esto es cosa
de {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}, {Player}!
¡Usemos la fuerza de la {Color:Red}espada
cuádruple{Color:White} para {Color:Blue}liberarlos{Color:White} de este
maleficio!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8D}What? ...What is this?
What's happened here!?
They've been turned to stone! All of
them! The minister...and the guards!
Everyone in the castle, all just
like {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}...
This can only be the work of that evil
Vaati! What cruelty. {Player}!
We must use the power of the sacred
{Color:Red}Four Sword{Color:White} to {Color:Blue}undo this evil{Color:White}!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Once you've pulled off their {Color:Blue}iron masks{Color:White},
those guys are no trouble whatsoever.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Si conseguimos quitarles la {Color:Blue}máscara de
metal{Color:White}, no serán difíciles de vencer...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Once you've pulled off their {Color:Blue}iron masks{Color:White},
those guys are no trouble whatsoever.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Your sword won't make a dent in their
thorny armor!
{Color:Blue}Flip them over{Color:White} before you strike!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Con esos pinchos que tienen, la espada
no te servirá de mucho.
¡Tienes que {Color:Blue}darles la vuelta{Color:White}!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Your sword won't make a dent in their
thorny armor!
{Color:Blue}Flip them over{Color:White} before you strike!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}Don't panic, {Player}! {Color:Blue}Only one of
them is real!{Color:White} The rest are fakes!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}¡No te pongas nervioso, {Player}!
{Color:Blue}Sólo hay uno de verdad.{Color:White}
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8D}Don't panic, {Player}! {Color:Blue}Only one of
them is real!{Color:White} The rest are fakes!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}With their {Color:Blue}stone masks{Color:White} on, these
things can put up quite a fight.
If you just unmask them, though, they
won't pose much of a threat.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}Tranquilo, arrebátales la {Color:Blue}máscara
de piedra{Color:White} y podrás con ellos.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8D}With their {Color:Blue}stone masks{Color:White} on, these
things can put up quite a fight.
If you just unmask them, though, they
won't pose much of a threat.

messages.es_ref:
(?)
¡Ah, ya lo tengo!{Sound:00:92}
¡Tienes que {Color:Blue}saltar al tornado desde
arriba{Color:White}! ¡Qué listo soy, je, je!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}Whoa! How about that?! Of all the
places for them to hide a portal!
You've done well, my boy. Was that
intuition? Or...just a lucky guess?{Sound:00:90}
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}¡Vaya, qué susto! ¡Nunca pensé
que aquí hubiera una entrada!
Qué listo eres...
¿Tienes un sexto sentido o qué?{Sound:00:90}
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8D}Whoa! How about that?! Of all the
places for them to hide a portal!
You've done well, my boy. Was that
intuition? Or...just a lucky guess?{Sound:00:90}

messages.en:
{Sound:00:90}Hmn? There's something fishy about
this area...
I can't say exactly what, though...
Just something weird in general...
Don't you feel it?
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:90}(?)
Creo que aquí podría haber algo...
No sé..., pero es por aquí. ¿No sientes
algo al pasar por aquí tú también?
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:90}Hmn? There's something fishy about
this area...
I can't say exactly what, though...
Just something weird in general...
Don't you feel it?

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Whoa! So there WAS a portal
hidden there!
I knew I sensed something!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Anda... Así que había una entrada...
Ya decía yo que sentía algo extraño.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Whoa! So there WAS a portal
hidden there!
I knew I sensed something!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}So, this must be {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}...

It's a nasty, dank place, filled with
swampland and mire...
But we know there's an {Color:Red}element{Color:White} waiting
for us somewhere in here, so...
In we go! Come on, {Player}!
Into the muck with us!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}Así que ésta es la {Color:Green}región
inexplorada de Tabanta{Color:White}...
Este pantano es muy peligroso.
Sin embargo, debemos cruzarlo
para llegar hasta el siguiente
{Color:Red}elemento{Color:White}. ¡No podemos
rendirnos ahora, {Player}!
¡Vamos, vamos!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}So, this must be {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}...

It's a nasty, dank place, filled with
swampland and mire...
But we know there's an {Color:Red}element{Color:White} waiting
for us somewhere in here, so...
In we go! Come on, {Player}!
Into the muck with us!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Now, that is one nasty-looking statue!
That {Color:Blue}eye{Color:White} has such an evil glower to it.
messages.es_ref:
¡Qué estatua de piedra tan horrorosa!
Este {Color:Blue}ojo{Color:White} es muy extraño...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Now, that is one nasty-looking statue!
That {Color:Blue}eye{Color:White} has such an evil glower to it.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}There's only one thing to do here. Just
break those pots that are in the way!
Stand in front of them and press {Key:Right}
to {Color:Blue}lift them over your head{Color:White}.
Then press it again to {Color:Blue}throw them{Color:White}!
messages.es_ref:
¡Rompe los jarrones que te estorben!

Si pulsas el Botón {Key:Right} delante
de uno, lo {Color:Blue}levantarás{Color:White}. Y si lo vuelves
a pulsar, lo {Color:Blue}lanzarás{Color:White}.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}There's only one thing to do here. Just
break those pots that are in the way!
Stand in front of them and press {Key:Right}
to {Color:Blue}lift them over your head{Color:White}.
Then press it again to {Color:Blue}throw them{Color:White}!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}With this {Color:Red}small key{Color:White}, we should be able
to open any locked door here!
But I should warn you, {Color:Blue}once you've
used the key{Color:White}, {Color:Blue}it will vanish{Color:White} forever.
To use it, just stand in front of
a locked door and press {Key:Right}.
messages.es_ref:
Con esa {Color:Red}llave pequeña{Color:White}, podrás
abrir una puerta que esté cerrada.
Eso sí, {Color:Blue}sólo podrás utilizarla una
vez{Color:White}. Colócate delante de una puerta
y pulsa el Botón {Key:Right}.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}With this {Color:Red}small key{Color:White}, we should be able
to open any locked door here!
But I should warn you, {Color:Blue}once you've
used the key{Color:White}, {Color:Blue}it will vanish{Color:White} forever.
To use it, just stand in front of
a locked door and press {Key:Right}.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Do you see that lever? I think you
should be able to {Color:Blue}pull it{Color:White}.
Just stand in front of it and press {Key:Right}
to grab it, then press {Key:DDown} to pull.
messages.es_ref:
¿No podrías {Color:Blue}tirar{Color:White} de esa palanca?

Agárrala pulsando el Botón {Key:Right} y
después pulsando {Key:DDown} para tirar.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Do you see that lever? I think you
should be able to {Color:Blue}pull it{Color:White}.
Just stand in front of it and press {Key:Right}
to grab it, then press {Key:DDown} to pull.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Once you take hold of something with
{Key:Right}, use {Key:Dpad} to {Color:Blue}push{Color:White} or {Color:Blue}pull{Color:White} it.
This is extremely important, so I hope
you take pains to remember it!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Once you take hold of something with
{Key:Right}, use {Key:Dpad} to {Color:Blue}push{Color:White} or {Color:Blue}pull{Color:White} it.
This is extremely important, so I hope
you take pains to remember it!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Wow! Look at the size of that barrel!

Hm? Oh, right! Right! How silly of me!
It's not big{Symbol:16} {Color:Blue}we're just small{Color:White}!
messages.es_ref:
¡Qué barril tan gigantesco!

(?)
Ah, claro, claro, se me olvidaba...
No es que el barril sea gigantesco,
sino que {Color:Blue}nosotros somos diminutos{Color:White}.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Wow! Look at the size of that barrel!

Hm? Oh, right! Right! How silly of me!
It's not big{Symbol:16} {Color:Blue}we're just small{Color:White}!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Wha--!? Hey, be careful, my lad!
{Color:Blue}The barrel just moved{Color:White}!
messages.es_ref:
¡Eh!
¡Oye, {Color:Blue}el barril se ha movido{Color:White}!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Wha--!? Hey, be careful, my lad!
{Color:Blue}The barrel just moved{Color:White}!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}What we need now is something to
hold down this switch...
messages.es_ref:
Si tuviésemos algo para {Color:Blue}colocar
sobre ese interruptor{Color:White}...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}What we need now is something to
hold down this switch...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:90}Now what?

Unless we find a way to travel by
water, we won't be going much farther.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:90}Qué mal...

Si no podemos movernos por el agua,
no podremos avanzar...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:90}Now what?

Unless we find a way to travel by
water, we won't be going much farther.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}This must be what the humans who built
this mine used to get around in here.
Maybe we should hop in.

Hm? What? After all this, you don't
expect me to believe you're scared!
There's nothing to be afraid of here!
Come on, let's go!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Estas vagonetas las usaban los
hombres para moverse por la mina.
¿Nos montamos?

(?)
¿Qué ocurre?
¿No será que te da miedo?
Desde luego...
¿Cómo te puede dar miedo
una cosa así? ¡Vamos, monta!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}This must be what the humans who built
this mine used to get around in here.
Maybe we should hop in.

Hm? What? After all this, you don't
expect me to believe you're scared!
There's nothing to be afraid of here!
Come on, let's go!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:93}Sweet jumping jellyfish, that was awful!
Hey, kid, what are you smiling about?
I knew it was madness to risk our lives
in that rickety human contraption!
From now on, let's just stick to our
feet! Well, I mean...your feet.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:93}(?)
¿Qué ha sido eso?
¿Y esa cara de felicidad?
Cómo os gustan estos cacharros...
¡Con lo bien que se va a pie!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:93}Sweet jumping jellyfish, that was awful!
Hey, kid, what are you smiling about?
I knew it was madness to risk our lives
in that rickety human contraption!
From now on, let's just stick to our
feet! Well, I mean...your feet.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:91}Oh my! It looks really, REALLY
hot in that lava!
Trust me: falling into that would
be a bad idea. I'm sure you agree.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:91}Uf, qué calor hace aquí...
Como caigamos ahí... no lo contamos.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:91}Oh my! It looks really, REALLY
hot in that lava!
Trust me: falling into that would
be a bad idea. I'm sure you agree.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}How interesting! So there was a {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White}
hidden away in here, hm?
Whenever you want me to shrink you
down, just hop up here and press {Key:Right}!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}¡Anda! ¿Quién iba a decirnos que había
una {Color:Blue}entrada {Color:White}en un sitio así?
Si quieres que te ayude a menguar,
ponte encima y pulsa el Botón {Key:Right}.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}How interesting! So there was a {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White}
hidden away in here, hm?
Whenever you want me to shrink you
down, just hop up here and press {Key:Right}!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:90}Phew...! We barely made it! I was
certain we'd run out of time!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:90}Uf, casi no lo conseguimos. Pensé que
no llegábamos a tiempo. Qué nervios...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:90}Phew...! We barely made it! I was
certain we'd run out of time!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Hmn?! Did something just fall down,
or was it just my imagination?
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}(?)
¿No ha caído algo? Será cosa mía...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Hmn?! Did something just fall down,
or was it just my imagination?

messages.en:
{Sound:00:91}What?! This floor is made out of ice!

Be careful not to fall and freeze
your backside to the floor, {Player}!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:91}Ay, ay, ay...
¿Qué le ocurre a este suelo?
Es de hielo. Ten cuidado, no te vayas
a caer, {Player}.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:91}What?! This floor is made out of ice!

Be careful not to fall and freeze
your backside to the floor, {Player}!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Hm. It looks like something is frozen
inside this block of ice...
{Player}, why don't you go take a
look?
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Ahora que me fijo, este bloque
de hielo {Color:Blue}tiene algo dentro{Color:White}...
Mira, {Player}, ¿a que sí?
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Hm. It looks like something is frozen
inside this block of ice...
{Player}, why don't you go take a
look?

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Hey! The sunlight's shining through!

Ahhh... It's so nice and warm. I can
feel myself starting to defrost again.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Hey! The sunlight's shining through!

Ahhh... It's so nice and warm. I can
feel myself starting to defrost again.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}{04:10:00}Hey...!!

Well done, {Player}!
This looks to be the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}, all right.
But what will we do?

We can't even touch it while it's
trapped in that ice...
We'll need to melt it off somehow...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}¡No puede ser!

¿Qué vamos a hacer, {Player}?
No hay duda de que es un {Color:Red}elemento{Color:White}.
Pero ¿cómo vamos a sacarlo de este
bloque de hielo tan grande?
¿Crees que podríamos {Color:Blue}descongelarlo{Color:White}?
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}{04:10:00}Hey...!!

Well done, {Player}!
This looks to be the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}, all right.
But what will we do?

We can't even touch it while it's
trapped in that ice...
We'll need to melt it off somehow...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Of course! Sunlight! Once we get some
sunlight in to melt the ice,
that {Color:Red}element {Color:White}will be as good as ours!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}¡Ya está! ¡El sol!
Si abres la otra y entra el sol, seguro
que el hielo que rodea el {Color:Red}elemento{Color:White}
se derretirá.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Of course! Sunlight! Once we get some
sunlight in to melt the ice,
that {Color:Red}element {Color:White}will be as good as ours!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}We did it, {Player}!
Now we can take the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
That was a lot of trouble,
but we finally did it, and...
What in blazes!?

Hey, something's not right here!!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}¡Muy bien, {Player}!
Por fin accederemos al {Color:Red}elemento{Color:White}.
Mira que nos ha costado...

(!)

¡Aquí está ocurriendo algo!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}We did it, {Player}!
Now we can take the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
That was a lot of trouble,
but we finally did it, and...
What in blazes!?

Hey, something's not right here!!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}What!? What's this?!

That stupid Octorok stole our {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!

Don't just stand there! We've got to go
get it! {Player}! Now!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}¿Qué ocurre aquí?

¡Ese fantasma se ha llevado nuestro
{Color:Red}elemento{Color:White}! ¡Eh, {Player}, no podemos
quedarnos mirando cómo se lo lleva!
¡A por él! ¡Rápido!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8D}What!? What's this?!

That stupid Octorok stole our {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!

Don't just stand there! We've got to go
get it! {Player}! Now!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:91}{Player}! Where are you?
Are you still there under me?
It's so dark, I can't see my beak
in front of my face!
Watch your step! I don't want you
to trip over anything...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:91}¡{Player}! ¿Dónde estás?
¿Estás ahí debajo?
No veo nada de nada...
¡Camina con mucho cuidado!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:91}{Player}! Where are you?
Are you still there under me?
It's so dark, I can't see my beak
in front of my face!
Watch your step! I don't want you
to trip over anything...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Oh my! There was a portal hidden
in there?
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Nunca pensé que hubiera una entrada
oculta aquí... qué cosas, oye.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Oh my! There was a portal hidden
in there?

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}There's a fluffy cloud floating here.
It looks awfully comfortable.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Mira cómo flotan las nubes. Saltar
encima debe de ser un gustazo.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}There's a fluffy cloud floating here.
It looks awfully comfortable.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}That panel... I think if we stomped on
it hard enough, it might flip over...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}Si saltas con fuerza sobre ese panel,
creo que se daría la vuelta.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}That panel... I think if we stomped on
it hard enough, it might flip over...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}There's a strong gale blowing here!
Try not to get swept away!
And hold on to your hat!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}¡Qué fuerte sopla en viento!
Procura que no te arrastre.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}There's a strong gale blowing here!
Try not to get swept away!
And hold on to your hat!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Perhaps your sword could reflect the
blasts coming from those statues.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Seguro que puedes sacar con
la espada la bola que tiene la estatua
dentro de la boca.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Perhaps your sword could reflect the
blasts coming from those statues.

messages.en: {Sound:00:92}What in the world is that?!
messages.es_ref: {Sound:00:92}¿Qué es eso?
messages.pt: {Sound:00:92}What in the world is that?!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmmm... Yes, yes... It certainly
does look suspicious...
messages.es_ref: {Sound:00:8E}Mmm... Qué extraño...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmmm... Yes, yes... It certainly
does look suspicious...

messages.en: {Sound:00:91}Huh? Wha--? What in the world!?
messages.es_ref: {Sound:00:91}¿Qué es esto? ¿Qué?
messages.pt: {Sound:00:91}Huh? Wha--? What in the world!?

messages.en: {Sound:00:8F}My word! It's a treasure chest!
messages.es_ref: {Sound:00:8F}¡Eh, un tesoro!
messages.pt: {Sound:00:8F}My word! It's a treasure chest!

messages.en: {Sound:00:8F}There seems to be a switch here!
messages.es_ref: {Sound:00:8F}¡Eh, un interruptor!
messages.pt: {Sound:00:8F}There seems to be a switch here!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8F}Oh, a {Color:Red}Piece of Heart{Color:White}!
Well, that IS useful.
messages.es_ref: {Sound:00:8F}¡Eh, un {Color:Red}contenedor de corazón{Color:White}!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8F}Oh, a {Color:Red}Piece of Heart{Color:White}!
Well, that IS useful.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}So this is your house...
Well, it seems like a nice place.
...So, where's my room?
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}Así que ésta es tu casa...
Es muy bonita. {Color:Blue}¿Dónde está mi cuarto?
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}So this is your house...
Well, it seems like a nice place.
...So, where's my room?

messages.en:
{Sound:00:90}So! This is your room? That makes it
my room, too, right?
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:90}Ajá, así que ésta es tu habitación.
Supongo que eso quiere decir
que {Color:Blue}es mi habitación también{Color:White}...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:90}So! This is your room? That makes it
my room, too, right?

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}I sense something unusual here...
Is it something hidden?
I won't tell anyone, so come on!
Show me!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Creo que hay algo extraño en esta

{Sound:00:8E}So only the {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}can repair
the {Color:Red}sword{Color:White}, hm?
Maybe we should find out what the
other {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}know about that.

{Sound:00:8D}You've never actually seen the

folk. Yes{01:0A}...mostly...

{Sound:00:8D}It sounds dangerous in there!{01:0A} We'd
better be careful...
{01:01}I mean, you'd better be careful!

{Sound:00:8E}Un {Color:Green}sepulcro{Color:White} repleto de enemigos...

En serio, no nos pongas en peligro.

I'm sure you can find some kind
of clue nearby.

shrine and found the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White}!

{Sound:00:8E}¡Has salido airoso de tu encuentro con

en realidad es mío, que te he salvado
el pellejo, pero bueno...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}{01:0A}We need to learn how to reforge
the broken {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White}.

{Sound:00:8D}Well? What are you waiting for!? Evil

{Sound:00:8D}¡No perdamos más tiempo!
¡Vamos a verlo!

en la siguiente aventura?

Just where do you think you're
taking us, anyway?
Look at a {Color:Red}map {Color:White}or something! Just
press START to see it.

¿Adónde me vas a llevar?
Avanza consultando el {Color:Red}mapa{Color:White}.
¡No tienes más que pulsar START!

What? You have?
...What's it like?
{Sound:00:8D}Not that I... I mean, I've seen it

I'm very well traveled. I just wanted
to see...what you thought of it!

{Sound:00:92}¿Has estado alguna vez en

¿Qué? ¿En serio? ¿Cómo es?
{Sound:00:8D}No, no..., ¡si yo también he estado!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}{Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White} is a forbidding and
rocky place with many steep cliffs.
It lies just west of {Color:Green}Hyrule Town{Color:White}.

We ought to equip ourselves in town
before risking the journey.

{Sound:00:8E}El {Color:Green}monte Gongol{Color:White} se eleva al oeste de

bajar a la {Color:Green}ciudadela{Color:White} a por lo básico

messages.es_ref:

Ya se han acabado las fiestas minish.
Me hubiera encantado verlas...
{Sound:00:92}Supongo que la {Color:Green}ciudadela{Color:White} cambia
mucho durante las fiestas...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Look at all these shops! This is so
different from {Color:Green}Minish Village{Color:White}!
I-I-I... I can't decide where to
go next!
Come on, my boy! Let's go shopping!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}¡Cuántas tiendas hay en la {Color:Green}ciudadela
de Hyrule{Color:White}! No como en la comunidad
de los minish del bosque. Vamos a
visitar las tiendas. ¡Qué divertido!

I-I-I... I can't decide where to
go next!

messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Que no se te olvide lo que debemos

{Sound:00:90}Claro que no sé cómo vamos

Parece que en el {Color:Green}monte Gongol{Color:White} también
hay enemigos como en el bosque...
{Sound:00:90}Nos va a costar llegar hasta {Color:Green}Melta{Color:White}.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}Oh, hey! I totally forgot!

That sword technique you learned from
the swordsman...
The {Color:Red}Spin Attack{Color:White}, that's what it's
called, right? That is so incredible!
{Sound:00:92}Do you think you could teach
it to me sometime?
Hm?! Hey! Don't give me that look!
I can do anything that you can do!
{Sound:00:8D}Just give me some arms, and I'll
show you what's what!

{Sound:00:8D}¡Por cierto! ¡Se me olvidaba!

Creo que estudiaste el {Color:Red}arte de la
espada{Color:White} con el maestro {Color:Green}Tesshin{Color:White}...
¿No aprendiste un movimiento llamado
{Color:Red}"ataque circular"{Color:White} o algo parecido?
{Sound:00:92}Es un ataque muy guay. ¿Me enseñarás
cómo se hace algún día?
{Sound:00:8D}(?) ¿Por qué me miras así? No creerás
que no soy capaz de hacerlo, ¿eh?
¡Ya verás!

{Sound:00:92}Encima, como los minish son tan

At times like these, try everything you
can at spots that {Color:Blue}seem like dead ends{Color:White}!
Sometimes, you can find a way hidden in
the most unlikely of spots!
...Um, sometimes.

el camino a seguir está semioculto...

{Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}...
Creatures I've never seen before, and
your sword alone won't beat them!
Don't give up hope, though! Try your
other {Color:Red}items{Color:White} on them!
Well...you don't need me to tell you
how to do your job.
Just deal with those monsters, and
I'll take care of everything else.{01:0A}

porque igual hay algunos imposibles

Si te encuentras un enemigo así,
no dudes en probar {Color:Red}otros métodos{Color:White}...
¡Tú, ocúpate de los enemigos,
que yo me echaré una siesta!

might have some useful information!
...Not that I've been reading them
either...

¿Otra vez no sabes qué hacer?
¿Has ido leyendo los {Color:Blue}carteles{Color:White} que

messages.es_ref:

the {Color:Green}Mountain Minish{Color:White}?
They're just a little different from
the Forest Minish, aren't they?
There seem to be many kinds of Minish,
just as there are many kinds of human.
And...many kinds of hat, too.
Mustn't forget the hats.

you lazy boy!
We have to go search for the {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}
while Melari works on that sword!

{Sound:00:8D}Y todo gracias a mí...

messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}Para otorgar el poder de los {Color:Red}elementos{Color:White}
a la {Color:Red}espada{Color:White}, debemos ir al {Color:Green}santuario{Color:White}.
Y dicen que la entrada está en el
{Color:Green}castillo de Hyrule{Color:White}...
Tú te sabes bien el camino al {Color:Green}castillo{Color:White},
vamos, no perdamos tiempo.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}So of the four {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}, we've got
Earth and Fire...
And now, we have the {Color:Red}White Sword{Color:White}
to absorb their power!
That means the sacred blade's power
has almost been restored!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Ya tenemos dos de los cuatro
{Color:Red}elementos{Color:White}: el de tierra y el de fuego.
Y al darle sus poderes a la espada,
hemos conseguido la {Color:Red}espada blanca{Color:White}.
¡Estamos cerca de nuestro objetivo!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}So of the four {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}, we've got
Earth and Fire...
And now, we have the {Color:Red}White Sword{Color:White}
to absorb their power!
That means the sacred blade's power
has almost been restored!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:91}Why do you look so confused? Don't you
understand what's going on?{01:0A}
{01:01}The {Color:Green}elemental sanctuary {Color:White}exists between
the human world and the Minish world.
Here, let me explain with a little
example: in a ham sandwich...
the elemental sanctuary would be the
ham between the two slices of bread!
...You've still got that look.
Did I just make it more confusing?
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:91}Por la cara que has puesto, creo que
te has vuelto a perder...
El {Color:Green}santuario{Color:White} es la puerta que une el
mundo de los minish y el de los hombres.
Este fantástico lugar es como el jamón
de un bocadillo. Las dos tapas de pan
serían los mundos. ¿Lo entiendes?
¿Te he liado más?
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:91}Why do you look so confused? Don't you
understand what's going on?{01:0A}
{01:01}The {Color:Green}elemental sanctuary {Color:White}exists between
the human world and the Minish world.
Here, let me explain with a little
example: in a ham sandwich...
the elemental sanctuary would be the
ham between the two slices of bread!
...You've still got that look.
Did I just make it more confusing?

messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}Vamos, debemos otorgar el poder
de los {Color:Red}elementos{Color:White} a la espada...
¿Cómo? No lo sé.
Ya se nos ocurrirá algo...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}I think that you and I may be the only
ones who can see the mystic doorway...
Well, that's fine by me. That means
no one will notice anything unusual!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Creo que sólo tú y yo podemos
ver la entrada al {Color:Green}santuario{Color:White}.
Hasta ahora, nadie la ha visto.
¡Allá vamos!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}I think that you and I may be the only
ones who can see the mystic doorway...
Well, that's fine by me. That means
no one will notice anything unusual!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}We just need to infuse the {Color:Red}sword{Color:White} with
the power of these two {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}.
Then, the sacred blade will be
nearly complete!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Cuando otorguemos el poder de los
dos {Color:Red}elementos{Color:White} a la {Color:Red}espada{Color:White}, estaremos
a medio camino de conseguir la {Color:Red}espada
sagrada{Color:White}.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}We just need to infuse the {Color:Red}sword{Color:White} with
the power of these two {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}.
Then, the sacred blade will be
nearly complete!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Only two {Color:Red}elements{Color:White} remain!

They must be in the places marked on
your {Color:Red}map{Color:White} by the Minish elder!
Why don't we take another look at that
map? If memory serves me correctly...{01:0A}
{01:01}There should be a mark out on the
westernmost edge of {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}¡Ya sólo nos faltan dos {Color:Red}elementos{Color:White}!

¡Deben de estar en las marcas que el
sabio anciano pintó en nuestro {Color:Red}mapa{Color:White}!
¿Por qué no compruebas el mapa?
Si no recuerdo mal, había uno detrás
de la {Color:Green}región inexplorada de Tabanta{Color:White},
al oeste.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Only two {Color:Red}elements{Color:White} remain!

They must be in the places marked on
your {Color:Red}map{Color:White} by the Minish elder!
Why don't we take another look at that
map? If memory serves me correctly...{01:0A}
{01:01}There should be a mark out on the
westernmost edge of {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}So the {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White} has finally started
to show us a portion of its power!
If we use this new skill of yours well,
we should be able to access new areas!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}La {Color:Red}espada{Color:White} empieza a mostrar su
fuerza. Con el poder para dividirte,
llegarás a lugares antes
inalcanzables. Eso creo...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}So the {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White} has finally started
to show us a portion of its power!
If we use this new skill of yours well,
we should be able to access new areas!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}If you're after the {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}, just
check your {Color:Red}map{Color:White} by pressing START.
I believe the elder of the Forest
Minish marked the locations there.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Los {Color:Red}elementos{Color:White} que nos faltan están
marcados en el {Color:Red}mapa{Color:White}. ¿Recuerdas?
El sabio anciano del bosque los señaló.
Pulsa START para consultarlo.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}If you're after the {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}, just
check your {Color:Red}map{Color:White} by pressing START.
I believe the elder of the Forest
Minish marked the locations there.

messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}Mmm... Según el {Color:Red}mapa{Color:White}, el siguiente
elemento se encuentra al sureste
de Hyrule, en la {Color:Green}región inexplorada
de Tabanta{Color:White}. ¡Vamos allá!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:90}The swamp covering {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White} looks
{Color:Blue}impassable on foot{Color:White}. What will we do!?{01:0A}
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:90}{Color:Blue}No puedes atravesar{Color:White} el pantano que
cubre la {Color:Green}región inexplorada de
Tabanta{Color:White} a pie... ¿Cómo lo harás?
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:90}The swamp covering {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White} looks
{Color:Blue}impassable on foot{Color:White}. What will we do!?{01:0A}

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, how long has it been since
you left home?
Your grandfather must be worried.
Why don't you show your face at home?
He must have plenty of news to share
with you by now.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, ¿cuánto hace que te
marchaste de casa? Seguro que tu
abuelo estará preocupado. Deberías
volver de vez en cuando para saludar.
Tendrás tantas cosas que contarle...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}{Player}, how long has it been since
you left home?
Your grandfather must be worried.
Why don't you show your face at home?
He must have plenty of news to share
with you by now.

messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:90}Ah...
Me está entrando sueño hasta a mí...
Con la {Color:Red}seta despertador{Color:White},
lo solucionaríamos en un momento.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Hoho! Well...

{Sound:00:8E}The big lake spreading out to the west
of Hyrule is {Color:Green}Lake Hylia{Color:White}.
The rich water that flows from it has
fed the {Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White} for millennia.
Every day, you learn something new,
don't you, {Player}?
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}¡Ejem! Mmm...

{Sound:00:8E}El lago que se encuentra al este
de Hyrule es el {Color:Green}lago de Hylia{Color:White}.
El agua tranquila de ese lago fluye
hasta llegar al {Color:Green}bosque minish{Color:White}
que está al sur. ¿Te has enterado,
{Player}?
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Hoho! Well...

{Sound:00:8E}The big lake spreading out to the west
of Hyrule is {Color:Green}Lake Hylia{Color:White}.
The rich water that flows from it has
fed the {Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White} for millennia.
Every day, you learn something new,
don't you, {Player}?

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}Well, I say! There seem to be a lot of
Minish living in town, too...
Even if they can't be seen, I'm sure the
Minish make their presence known...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}En la ciudadela viven muchos {Color:Green}minish{Color:White}.
Los hombres no podrán verlos, pero
me da a mí que se huelen algo...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}Well, I say! There seem to be a lot of
Minish living in town, too...
Even if they can't be seen, I'm sure the
Minish make their presence known...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}So, about that {Color:Red}wake-up mushroom{Color:White} you
just bought... It kind of, um...smells.
COUGH! COUGH!

{Sound:00:91}I suppose that awful stink could pull
anyone from the deepest slumber!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Esa {Color:Red}seta despertador{Color:White} que has
comprado huele fatal... ¡Puaj, puaj!
{Sound:00:91}Desde luego, si te la ponen delante
de la nariz, ¡te despiertan seguro!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}So, about that {Color:Red}wake-up mushroom{Color:White} you
just bought... It kind of, um...smells.
COUGH! COUGH!

{Sound:00:91}I suppose that awful stink could pull
anyone from the deepest slumber!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:90}Hey, {Player}. I've been up here for
a while, and I've been wondering...
I know about hats now, but I don't
know much about Hyrulean shoes...
Where could we go to learn a little
more about that?
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:90}Oye, {Player}, no he podido quitarme
de la cabeza lo del zapatero de la
ciudadela... ¿Habrá hecho los zapatos
de la princesa Zelda a tiempo?
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:90}Hey, {Player}. I've been up here for
a while, and I've been wondering...
I know about hats now, but I don't
know much about Hyrulean shoes...
Where could we go to learn a little
more about that?

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}So about that old lady in the woods
named {Color:Green}Syrup{Color:White} or something...
Didn't she strike you as a little
bit, well, strange?
I'm confident that her {Color:Red}potions{Color:White} work
as advertised, though.
She looks like someone who could whip
up a mean magic brew...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}La anciana del bosque, la tal {Color:Green}Sirope{Color:White},
era de lo más extraña. Eso sí, me creo
que las {Color:Red}pócimas{Color:White} que vendía fueran
las mejores de la región, ¿y tú?
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}So about that old lady in the woods
named {Color:Green}Syrup{Color:White} or something...
Didn't she strike you as a little
bit, well, strange?
I'm confident that her {Color:Red}potions{Color:White} work
as advertised, though.
She looks like someone who could whip
up a mean magic brew...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Once we cross {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}, the
{Color:Red}element{Color:White} should be easy to find.
If you forget where to go, just take
a look at your {Color:Red}map{Color:White}.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}En cuanto logres atravesar el pantano
que cubre la {Color:Green}región inexplorada de
Tabanta{Color:White}, llegarás al próximo {Color:Red}elemento{Color:White}.
Si olvidas dónde está, mira el {Color:Red}mapa{Color:White}.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Once we cross {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}, the
{Color:Red}element{Color:White} should be easy to find.
If you forget where to go, just take
a look at your {Color:Red}map{Color:White}.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}When you're crossing a swamp, you
want to be as swift as the wind...
There's no point in stopping to look
around. Sightseeing is right out!
What I'm trying to say is that I don't
much relish the thought of a mud bath!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}No cruces el pantano vacilando.
Debes pasar tan rápido como el viento.
¡Si no, nos hundiremos los dos!
¡Y no quiero llenarme de barro!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8D}When you're crossing a swamp, you
want to be as swift as the wind...
There's no point in stopping to look
around. Sightseeing is right out!
What I'm trying to say is that I don't
much relish the thought of a mud bath!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}That {Color:Blue}one-eyed stone{Color:White} statue in {Color:Green}Castor
Wilds{Color:White} looks like it's staring at us!
...That eye really creeps me out.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}La {Color:Blue}misteriosa estatua{Color:White} de piedra
de la {Color:Green}región inexplorada{Color:White} me da miedo...
Parece que nos estuviese mirando.
¿No te resulta sospechosa?
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}That {Color:Blue}one-eyed stone{Color:White} statue in {Color:Green}Castor
Wilds{Color:White} looks like it's staring at us!
...That eye really creeps me out.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}Creepy {Color:Green}ruins{Color:White} standing on the far side
of {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}...{01:0A}
{01:01}Maybe that's where the ancient people
who guarded the {Color:Red}element{Color:White} used to live.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}Nadie ha conseguido llegar nunca
hasta el otro lado de la {Color:Green}región
inexplorada de Tabanta{Color:White}. Parece que
allí descansan unas antiguas {Color:Green}ruinas{Color:White}.
Creo que son las ruinas del lugar que
habitaban los guardianes del {Color:Red}elemento{Color:White}.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}Creepy {Color:Green}ruins{Color:White} standing on the far side
of {Color:Green}Castor Wilds{Color:White}...{01:0A}
{01:01}Maybe that's where the ancient people
who guarded the {Color:Red}element{Color:White} used to live.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}That {Color:Red}element {Color:White}is sure to be protected by
traps inside those ancient ruins!
{Player}, be careful!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Las trampas de estas ruinas protegen
el {Color:Red}elemento{Color:White}. {Player}, ten cuidado.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}That {Color:Red}element {Color:White}is sure to be protected by
traps inside those ancient ruins!
{Player}, be careful!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}Don't just wander around aimlessly...
That's the quickest way to get lost!
If you do get lost, look at your {Color:Red}map{Color:White}
immediately to get your bearings.
You will find your way only if you know
where you are AND where you're going.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}Si caminas sin rumbo, te perderás. Mira
bien el {Color:Red}mapa{Color:White}, que para eso lo tienes.
Si sabes dónde estás y adónde vas,
no deberías tener problema.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8D}Don't just wander around aimlessly...
That's the quickest way to get lost!
If you do get lost, look at your {Color:Red}map{Color:White}
immediately to get your bearings.
You will find your way only if you know
where you are AND where you're going.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}The next {Color:Red}element{Color:White} is near {Color:Green}Lake Hylia{Color:White}.
Now, how are we going to get there?
I wonder who might be able to help
us out with something like that...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Parece que el siguiente {Color:Red}elemento{Color:White}
está en algún lugar del {Color:Green}lago de Hylia{Color:White}.
¿Cómo podremos llegar hasta allí?
¿Quién nos podrá indicar cómo llegar?
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}The next {Color:Red}element{Color:White} is near {Color:Green}Lake Hylia{Color:White}.
Now, how are we going to get there?
I wonder who might be able to help
us out with something like that...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}All we have to do is use the {Color:Red}Ocarina of
Wind{Color:White} to call Zeffa!
If we stand on a {Color:Blue}Wind Crest{Color:White} and call
him, he'll take us where we want to go!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}Si llamamos al grupo de los pájaros
con la {Color:Red}ocarina del viento{Color:White}, podremos
llegar a cualquier sitio. Podrás viajar
hasta cualquier {Color:Blue}señal del viento{Color:White}.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8D}All we have to do is use the {Color:Red}Ocarina of
Wind{Color:White} to call Zeffa!
If we stand on a {Color:Blue}Wind Crest{Color:White} and call
him, he'll take us where we want to go!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}Well, now that we've got this {Color:Red}Ocarina
of Wind{Color:White}, shouldn't we try to use it?
Even places we've seen before may hold
new surprises if we try flying there...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}Ya que has conseguido la {Color:Red}ocarina del
viento{Color:White}, vuela a distintos sitios, aunque
ya los conozcas.
Puedes encontrar nuevas pistas...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8D}Well, now that we've got this {Color:Red}Ocarina
of Wind{Color:White}, shouldn't we try to use it?
Even places we've seen before may hold
new surprises if we try flying there...

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}Well, I'd never have suspected it of
that {Color:Green}Minish elder{Color:White} in the {Color:Green}library{Color:White}...
To think he was an adventurer! And
that he visited the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White}!
Maybe we should look up that {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White}
and hear what he has to say.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}A quién se le habría ocurrido que un
{Color:Green}anciano minish{Color:White} que vive en la {Color:Green}biblioteca{Color:White}
podría haber estado en el {Color:Green}templo
de las aguas{Color:White}... Menuda sorpresa.
Debemos hablar con {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} enseguida.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}Well, I'd never have suspected it of
that {Color:Green}Minish elder{Color:White} in the {Color:Green}library{Color:White}...
To think he was an adventurer! And
that he visited the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White}!
Maybe we should look up that {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White}
and hear what he has to say.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}Hm. Now, how did {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} get into
the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White}?
I guess we'll just have to go visit
him at the library and ask.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}Entonces, ¿cómo llegó {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} hasta
el {Color:Green}templo de las aguas{Color:White}?
Mmm...

Deberíamos hablar con él en la
{Color:Green}biblioteca{Color:White}.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}Hm. Now, how did {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} get into
the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White}?
I guess we'll just have to go visit
him at the library and ask.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}So, where in the library would any
Minish folk live, anyway?
Maybe those people who say the Minish
exist "{Color:Blue}only in stories{Color:White}" might be right!
Hey! {Player}! What's that look for?
Don't tell me you were one of...them?
You're kidding me! You're wearing a
Minish person on your head, you oaf!
I certainly hope you believe in us now!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}¿Dónde viviría un minish en la
{Color:Green}biblioteca{Color:White}? ¡Claro, {Color:Blue}dentro de un libro{Color:White}!
{Player}, ¿por qué me miras así?
¡No te crees nada de lo que te digo!
Aunque ahora sea un gorro,
te recuerdo, jovencito, que yo también
he sido un minish. Así que fíate de mí.
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:92}So, where in the library would any
Minish folk live, anyway?
Maybe those people who say the Minish
exist "{Color:Blue}only in stories{Color:White}" might be right!
Hey! {Player}! What's that look for?
Don't tell me you were one of...them?
You're kidding me! You're wearing a
Minish person on your head, you oaf!
I certainly hope you believe in us now!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:91}How did we get roped into running all
over creation returning library books?
I understand it's all just to learn
how to enter the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White},
{Sound:00:8D}but this is hardly the sort of duty
worthy of a great adventurer!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:91}Al final nos han liado a nosotros para
recuperar los libros de la biblioteca...
Nosotros que veníamos a preguntar
cómo llegar hasta el {Color:Green}templo de las
aguas{Color:White}...
{Sound:00:8D}Menudo chasco...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:91}How did we get roped into running all
over creation returning library books?
I understand it's all just to learn
how to enter the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White},
{Sound:00:8D}but this is hardly the sort of duty
worthy of a great adventurer!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}Minish people are very interested in
human ways.
I think they watch the people in
town very closely.
They've probably been watching you,
too, without your knowing it.
Hey, {Player}, careful what you say
and do when you think you're alone!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8E}Los minish están muy interesados en
los hombres. Observan con atención
a los de la ciudadela sin que se den
cuenta. {Player}, no lo olvides...
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8E}Minish people are very interested in
human ways.
I think they watch the people in
town very closely.
They've probably been watching you,
too, without your knowing it.
Hey, {Player}, careful what you say
and do when you think you're alone!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8D}So there are three books that we're
supposed to return, right?
{Player}, I'm sure you can handle it!
Don't get me wrong! I'd love to help!
But I'm a great Minish sage! I don't
understand your big, human ways!
{Sound:00:8D}So...I'm counting on you!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:8D}Muy bien, tenemos que conseguir tres
libros. Lo dejo en tus manos,{Player}.
Yo te ayudaría, pero esto es un asunto
de hombres y no sé ni dónde buscar...
{Sound:00:8D}¡Así que te toca a ti!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:8D}So there are three books that we're
supposed to return, right?
{Player}, I'm sure you can handle it!
Don't get me wrong! I'd love to help!
But I'm a great Minish sage! I don't
understand your big, human ways!
{Sound:00:8D}So...I'm counting on you!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:91}This really is starting to take valuable
time from our search for the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
{Sound:00:92}But buck up, kiddo! We're almost
done, {Player}!!!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:91}Hay que ver lo que estamos pasando
para conseguir el siguiente {Color:Red}elemento{Color:White}...
¡No podemos rendirnos!
{Sound:00:92}¡Levanta el ánimo, {Player}!
messages.pt:
{Sound:00:91}This really is starting to take valuable
time from our search for the {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
{Sound:00:92}But buck up, kiddo! We're almost
done, {Player}!!!

messages.en:
{Sound:00:8E}You know, even these Minish living in
the town still have their own troubles.
I feel like I've learned a lot here.
messages.es_ref:

you're in the water...
And let's face it, if something hits you
in the head while you're swimming...
I'm going to be the one who gets
the worst of it.
So please, remember that. For my sake,
{Player}!

{Sound:00:92}Entonces, con las {Color:Red}aletas{Color:White} que te

immediately to get your bearings.
You will find your way only if you know
where you are AND where you're going.

no deberías tener problema.

sanctuary{Color:White}!

siguiente señal en el {Color:Red}mapa{Color:White} si queremos
averiguar algo más...
Pero, primero, vayamos al {Color:Green}santuario{Color:White}
para otorgar el poder de ese {Color:Red}elemento
{Color:White}a la espada. ¡Adelante!

going on here...

Too quickly, in fact!
Can't you go any slower? Surely
you've noticed that I have no legs...

really think I can walk that fast!?
messages.es_ref:

¡¿Pero no te das cuenta de que no
puedo caminar tan rápido como tú?!
messages.pt:

messages.en:
{Sound:01:E4}Augh!

If it isn't one thing, it's another!
You are a troublesome boy!

messages.pt:

messages.en:
{Sound:00:5F}There! Now, you can't possibly
leave me behind.
My... It's quite comfortable up here.
More comfortable than it looks, surely.
And much easier on me!

Hey! Quit your squirming! Can't
you sit still? See! There...
Yes, yes! That's it. Much better.

Now, I suppose a boy like you still has
much to learn about the world.
If ever you need my insight, press
{Color:Blue}SELECT{Color:White}. I'll be happy to help!
Ah, such a hopeless child...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:5F}Muy bien. Así no me separaré de ti.

Tengo una vista estupenda desde
aquí arriba.
Además, así no me canso.

Eh, ¿qué haces?
¡Vamos! ¡Camina! ¡Venga!
Como eres realmente joven, habrá
muchas cosas que no entiendas...

Creo que me vas a dar mucho la lata...

messages.en:
I gather it's been quite some time
since they last saw a human.
...What's that? You didn't understand
what they were saying just now?
Ah, yes. That was the language
of the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.
It's a little different from the dialect
I am most familiar with.
I'm afraid I didn't catch most
of what they said myself.
But perhaps there is someone here
who {Color:Blue}understands your language{Color:White}.
We should look around.
messages.es_ref:
Están diciendo que hacía mucho que no
veían a un hombre por aquí, ¿verdad?
Vaya... Creo que no has entendido
nada de lo que han dicho.
Hablan la lengua de los {Color:Green}minish{Color:White}.
Es muy complicada, incluso para mí.
No importa, seguro que hay al menos
un minish que entiende la {Color:Blue}lengua de
los hombres{Color:White}. Vamos a buscar.

messages.en:
Fortunately, the {Color:Red}Earth Element {Color:White}is in the
{Color:Green}shrine {Color:White}at the far end of the village.
A horde of beasts lives in that {Color:Green}shrine{Color:White},
though, so enter with caution.
messages.es_ref:
Encontraréis el {Color:Red}elemento de tierra{Color:White} en el
pequeño {Color:Green}sepulcro{Color:White} que hay al fondo de
nuestra comunidad. Eso sí, debéis
tener mucho cuidado porque está lleno
de seres terribles...

{Sound:02:0D}Oh! You speak our language!

It's been quite a while since we've
heard outsiders speak our tongue!
We have little to offer you in these
woods, but please, enjoy your stay.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:02:0D}¡Qué sorpresa! ¡Hablas {Color:Green}nuestra lengua{Color:White}!

en nuestra pequeña comunidad.
messages.pt:
{Sound:02:0D}Oh! You speak our language!

It's been quite a while since we've

We have little to offer you in these
woods, but please, enjoy your stay.

messages.en:
Thank you for your offer, but we have
no time to relax. My name is {Color:Green}Ezlo{Color:White}.
This child is {Player}.

We need to break a {Color:Blue}curse {Color:White}that has
been cast on the princess of Hyrule.
To do so, we'll need to reforge
the broken {Color:Red}Picori Blade{Color:White}.
messages.es_ref:
¡No, no, no! Gracias por la invitación,
pero no tenemos tiempo de hacer
turismo. Me llamo {Color:Green}Ezero{Color:White} y este joven 
es {Player}.
Hemos venido para reforjar la {Color:Red}espada
minish{Color:White} y deshacer el {Color:Blue}maleficio{Color:White} que
un villano ha lanzado sobre la joven
princesa de Hyrule.
messages.pt:
Thank you for your offer, but we have
no time to relax. My name is {Color:Green}Ezlo{Color:White}.
This child is {Player}.

We need to break a {Color:Blue}curse {Color:White}that has
been cast on the princess of Hyrule.
To do so, we'll need to reforge
the broken {Color:Red}Picori Blade{Color:White}.

messages.en:
Ah, yes. And you've come here now
hoping to have the blade reforged?
Hm... Well, if that's what you're after,
you'll need four mystic {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}.
These elements are the crystalline
forms of the energies of this world.
Only by {Color:Blue}infusing the blade{Color:White} with these
energies can a new blade be forged.
Here, give me your map. I can mark
where these {Color:Red}elements{Color:White} can be found.
messages.es_ref:
Ya veo... Así que habéis venido
para reforjar la espada minish.
Pues reforjarla no bastará para
recuperar la espada sagrada.
Deberéis llevar a cabo el ritual
de los cuatro {Color:Red}elementos{Color:White}.
Atribuiréis los poderes de los cuatro
{Color:Red}elementos{Color:White} a la espada para {Color:Blue}recuperar
la espada sagrada{Color:White}.

Ahora os diré dónde empezar a buscar
los {Color:Red}elementos{Color:White}.

messages.en:
The {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White} can be found in the
{Color:Green}shrine{Color:White} to the north of {Color:Green}Festari{Color:White}'s abbey.
Speak with {Color:Green}Festari{Color:White}. He will show you the
path to the {Color:Green}shrine{Color:White}'s entrance.
Go with caution. Evil creatures have
lately made their home in our {Color:Green}shrine{Color:White}.
Return to me at once after you have
found the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White}.
messages.es_ref:
El primer elemento que debéis conseguir
es el {Color:Red}elemento de tierra{Color:White}. Lo hallaréis
en el {Color:Green}sepulcro{Color:White}, que se encuentra al
norte de la casa del sacerdote de
nuestra comunidad. {Color:Green}Festa{Color:White} os indicará
cómo llegar hasta allí. Las tinieblas
se han apoderado de ese lugar...
Así que tened mucho cuidado. Buscad el
{Color:Red}elemento de tierra{Color:White} y volved aquí.
messages.pt:

messages.en:
{Sound:02:0D}So! You have found the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White}!

You are blessed with much courage and
strength for one so young.
If your conviction holds strong, head
to {Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}.
There, you will find a man named {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}.

Among all the Minish, there is no one
more able to repair your sword.
If you ask him, I am certain he will
reforge your {Color:Red}broken Picori Blade{Color:White}.
I shall send word to him in advance.

Travel safely. You are brave, but
there are many evils now in the world.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:02:0D}¡Oh! ¡Habéis conseguido
el {Color:Red}elemento de tierra{Color:White}!
Es una gran hazaña para un joven
héroe como tú.
Si quieres continuar tu aventura, ve al
{Color:Green}monte Gongol{Color:White}. Allí encontrarás a {Color:Green}Melta{Color:White}.
Melta es el único minish capaz
de reforjar la {Color:Red}espada minish{Color:White} rota. 
Seguro que si le explicas lo ocurrido,
la arreglará.
De todas formas, me aseguraré de
hablar con él antes de que tú llegues.

messages.en:
Once you {Color:Blue}infuse it with the power of the
elements{Color:White}, it will become a {Color:Red}sacred blade{Color:White}!
The forest elder no doubt told you
this part, but...
If you want to infuse the sword, you
must go to the {Color:Green}elemental sanctuary{Color:White}.
The {Color:Green}sanctuary{Color:White} is a strange realm,
trapped between two worlds.
It is the bridge between the Minish
world and the human world.
The doorway to the {Color:Green}sanctuary {Color:White}opens
only once every hundred years!
You'll find that door hidden
within {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}.
Once the blade has been filled with
the power of the four {Color:Red}elements{Color:White},
you should be able to break the
curse on your princess.
I know you can do it. After all, you
made short work of that human mine.
Let me tell you about a shortcut you
can use to get down from the mountain.
You'll find it right in front of the
entrance of the mine you just explored.
Just follow that, and you'll be down
in no time. Good luck!
messages.es_ref:
Dicen que si {Color:Blue}otorgas los poderes
de los cuatro elementos{Color:White} a la espada,
se convertirá en una {Color:Red}espada sagrada{Color:White}.
El anciano del bosque me ha contado
que para otorgarle los poderes debes
ir al {Color:Green}santuario{Color:White}.
El santuario está entre el mundo de
los minish y el mundo de los hombres.
La entrada a los dos mundos está en
algún lugar del {Color:Green}castillo de Hyrule
{Color:White}y sólo se abre una vez cada
cien años. Cuando hayas otorgado
el poder de los {Color:Red}cuatro elementos
{Color:White}a la {Color:Red}espada{Color:White}, podrás pedir un deseo.
¡Seguro que lo consigues!
¡Ánimo en esta aventura!

messages.en:
Fool! A hat that grants the wishes of
its wearer is a spectacular creation!
Thanks to you, I have gone from being
a meek, miniscule nothing to...
the greatest sorcerer alive!

You cannot stop me now, and
I have you to thank for it!
Accept this small gesture
of gratitude from me.
messages.es_ref:
Es una creación fabulosa, maestro.
Hace realidad los deseos de quien lo
lleva puesto. Gracias a él estoy en
la cima del mundo....
Mi magia no tiene parangón en este
mundo. Nadie podrá detener mi plan.
Y se lo debo todo a usted.
Quiero agradecérselo con un presente.

messages.en:
That foul {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}! What could he be
scheming now?
{Player}... I feel I owe you an
explanation of what has happened.
You see, Vaati and I are both {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.

I was once a famous sage and a
renowned {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}craftsman.
Vaati was only a boy when I took him
on as my apprentice.
But...he became enchanted by the
wickedness in the hearts of men.
One day, Vaati took a hat I made for
the humans--my pride and joy.
It granted the wishes of its wearer.
He put it on without permission...
messages.es_ref:
¿Qué estará planeando {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White} ahora?

Oye, {Player}.
Creo que ha llegado el momento de
contarte toda la historia...
Vaati y yo somos {Color:Green}minish{Color:White}...
Sí, sí, como lo oyes...
Yo era un científico de cierta
reputación{Symbol:16} y Vaati, mi mejor alumno...
A Vaati siempre le atrajo el lado
oscuro del corazón de los hombres.
Un día se hizo con el gorro minish que
yo había creado para hacer realidad
los deseos de los hombres...

messages.en:
You know the legends, of course. The
gifts the Picori gave the humans...
What you call the {Color:Red}Picori Blade{Color:White} was
the first of those gifts. The second...
Well, you call it {Color:Red}light force{Color:White}, but it is
a source of limitless magical power.
If {Color:Green}Vaati {Color:White}were to get it now, it would
be devastating.
I came to the world of men hoping to
stop Vaati, and I met you in the woods.
But it seems we won't be breaking
the curse on me anytime soon.
However, with the sacred blade, we can
certainly restore {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}.
I'm sorry. All that has happened has
been due to my own pride. My folly.
I must rely on you, on your power,
until we've put an end to Vaati.

minish{Color:White}. La que cuenta que regalaron la

{Color:Red}espada minish{Color:White} a los hombres para
liberarles de las tinieblas. La {Color:Red}fuerza{Color:White}
otorga poderes ilimitados... Sería
terrible que Vaati se hiciese con ella.
Me dirigía al mundo de los hombres para
detenerle cuando nos encontramos en
el bosque minish. Parece que no
podré deshacerme del maleficio que
recae sobre mí, pero si conseguimos la
{Color:Red}espada sagrada{Color:White} al menos salvaremos a
la {Color:Green}princesa Zelda{Color:White}. Todo esto es culpa
mía. Lucharé hasta el final junto a ti.

messages.en:
We are the {Color:Green}Tribe of the Winds{Color:White}.

Long have we lived with the winds. We
have mastered them. Now, we join them.
Together, with the great winds at our
backs, we head for the skies.
Those who come seeking our power must
play the {Color:Blue}notes{Color:White} Zeffa teaches.
May they lead you onward to
the power that you seek.
messages.es_ref:
Nosotros, los {Color:Green}hijos del viento{Color:White}, siempre
hemos convivido en armonía con
el elemento de aire. Tras años,
conseguimos dominar el arte de los
vientos y, utilizando su fuerza,
abandonamos la tierra y partimos
hacia el cielo. Si quieres seguir
nuestros pasos, haz {Color:Blue}sonar{Color:White} el
instrumento que recibirás del
pájaro Roc o el camino no hallarás.

messages.en:
{Sound:01:E6}Allow me to introduce myself
to you, Princess Zelda.
My name is {Color:Green}Ezlo{Color:White}, master of Minish
lore and sorcery.
The mage's cap was my creation.

But its limitless power has caused
nothing but trouble for your kind.
Is there any way you can forgive me?

I know many have fallen, and much of
the castle has been destroyed...
But it is too soon to give
in to despair.
The curse on me is broken, and Zelda
still possesses some of the light force.
Perhaps, together, we can do
something to make things right.

Me llamo {Color:Green}Ezero{Color:White}, científico del país

de Hyrule ha sufrido grandes daños.
Pero no debemos desesperar.

con la {Color:Red}fuerza{Color:White} que le queda a la

podamos solucionarlo...

overflowing with the power of life!
The hat has the power to turn the
thoughts of its wearer into reality.
Vaati's heart was filled with evil, and

dorada que alberga la princesa Zelda
ilumine a vuestro pueblo muchos años.

keeping those monsters in that chest?
The rumor is that Vaati was looking for
something inside the chest...
I mean, something other than monsters.
But nobody knows for sure what it is.
I tell you, he sure has been nothing
but a big headache to the rest of us.

that before. Are you a...human?
Oh, my! It's been quite some time
since any humans came here.
My name is {Color:Green}Festari{Color:White}. I watch the abbey,
as well as the shrine to the north.
You...seem to be having some trouble
with our language, don't you?
You could use a {Color:Red}Jabber Nut{Color:White}. It will
allow you to understand our tongue.
You should be able to find one in
the barrel house just south of here.

el sacerdote de esta comunidad.
Estoy a cargo del pequeño {Color:Green}sepulcro{Color:White}
del fondo. Por cierto, si no entiendes
la lengua minish, tendrás problemas.
Al sur hay una casa en forma de barril,
en la que encontrarás un {Color:Red}fruto muy
especial{Color:White}: el frutabel.
Si lo comes, te entenderás con
los minish de nuestra comunidad.

finished milking our pride and joy.

you did us such a big favor...

friends-only price.

strength{Color:White}, just drink it up!
And if you run out, just bring
your empty bottle back for a refill!

messages.en:
{Sound:02:04}We forest {Color:Green}Minish{Color:Red} {Color:White}are good at
growing plants and making tools.
The {Color:Red}Minish Berries{Color:White} we grow here often
contain items that please the humans.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:02:04}Los {Color:Green}minish{Color:White} del bosque somos fabulosos
granjeros. Usamos el {Color:Red}fruto{Color:White} de nuestro
esfuerzo para crear pequeños objetos
que traigan suerte a los hombres.

messages.en:
{Sound:01:F9}There's a weird guy outside the village
who {Color:Blue}invents all kinds of tools{Color:White}.
He came to the village a while ago. We
thought maybe he was back for good.
But all he said was {Color:Blue}"Got any {Color:Red}milk{Color:Blue}?"{Color:White}
Maybe he was thirsty or something.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:F9}Hay un extraño científico de{Color:Blue} las
herramientas{Color:White} que vive a las afueras
de la comunidad. Hace poco pasó por
aquí y me preguntó si tenía {Color:Red}leche{Color:White}...
Qué cosa tan extraña...

messages.en:
{Sound:01:F7}Sometimes it's a flower seed, and
sometimes it's a stone.
We hide our lucky items in all sorts of
unexpected places.
But the real trick is making it tough
for humans to notice!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:F7}Creamos objetos de la suerte con
distintas formas: semillas, piedras...
Y nos esforzamos mucho para que
los hombres no se den cuenta.
¡Los escondemos en los sitios
más insospechados!

messages.en:
{Sound:02:05}Wow! Good job finding this place! There
aren't many people who visit me here.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:02:05}Ésta es la {Color:Blue}sala secreta{Color:White} donde venimos
a probar suerte con nuestras piedras.
¿Quieres que veamos si encajan?
messages.pt:
{Sound:02:05}Wow! Good job finding this place! There

messages.en: {Sound:01:FE}Hehhe! Great! Let's fuse now!
messages.es_ref: {Sound:01:FE}Je, je, je. ¡Probemos suerte!

messages.en:
{Sound:01:FF}Hehe! That's why I can't get enough
of Kinstone fusion!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:FF}¡Je, je, je! ¡Por eso no soy capaz
de dejar de probar suerte!
messages.pt:

¿No quieres probar suerte?

messages.en:
{Sound:01:F8}You've heard of travelers who find a
{Color:Red}Kinstone {Color:White}and get really lucky?
Well, that's all thanks to items made
by us {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}!
You see, we thrive on making humans
happy. It gives us energy.
But we only do it in secret!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:F8}¿No has oído nunca historias de gente
a la que le cambia la suerte tras
recoger una {Color:Red}piedra{Color:White} en el camino?
Eso es porque era una piedra de
la suerte que habíamos creado los
{Color:Green}minish{Color:White}. Al regalar buena fortuna,
nos sentimos mucho mejor también.

used the portal between our worlds.
It brought them into the human world,
and they settled in this forest.

{Sound:01:FB}Dicen que los antepasados de los
{Color:Green}minish{Color:White} cruzaron una puerta que une
este mundo y el de los hombres, para
llegar hasta este bosque.

messages.en:
{Sound:02:03}If you want to reforge that sword, you
will need the help of an expert smith!
{Color:Green}Master Melari{Color:White} and his seven
apprentices can help you.
They live in the mountains, where they
can find all the ore they need.
I'm sure the {Color:Green}elder {Color:White}would tell you about
him if you asked.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:02:03}Si quieres arreglar una espada,
deberías hablar con el {Color:Green}maestro
herrero Melta{Color:White} y sus siete ayudantes.
Viven en las minas. Seguro que el
{Color:Green}sabio anciano{Color:White} del bosque te indica
cómo encontrarlos.

He and his apprentices are skilled in
the arts of metalworking.
That's why they live in the mountain:
so they can be close to the ore!

{Sound:01:F9}There are so many monsters around
these woods lately!
The elder said that even the {Color:Green}shrine {Color:White}to
the north is filled with monsters now!

{Sound:01:F9}Últimamente ocurren cosas terribles.
El sacerdote cree que es por
los monstruos que han aparecido
en el {Color:Green}sepulcro{Color:White} que hay al norte.

messages.en:
{Sound:01:F8}Hey, nice clothes...
I want to wear human clothes, too!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:F8}¡Cómo me gusta tu forma de vestir!
Me gustaría probarme algo así.
messages.pt:
{Sound:01:F8}Hey, nice clothes...
I want to wear human clothes, too!

messages.en:
{Sound:01:F9}I was born and raised here, so I don't
know much about the outside world.
I hear there are HUGE green monsters
out there in the woods.
I can't believe you made it through
there alive! You must be really brave!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:F9}Yo he nacido y me he criado en este
lugar, así que no conozco nada fuera
de nuestra comunidad. Dicen que hay
unos monstruos verdes gigantes.
No sé cómo has podido cruzar
el bosque tú solo...
messages.pt:
{Sound:01:F9}I was born and raised here, so I don't
know much about the outside world.
I hear there are HUGE green monsters
out there in the woods.
I can't believe you made it through
there alive! You must be really brave!

messages.en:
{Sound:01:F9}That's it! I've decided!

When I grow up, I'm going to be human!
...I wonder how I'll do that...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:F9}¡Sí! ¡Eso es!

¡Cuando sea mayor, seré un hombre!
Bueno... si puede ser...
messages.pt:

...I wonder how I'll do that...

messages.en:
{Sound:01:FA}I'm getting set to leave for town and
visit some of my Minish friends there.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:FA}Voy de camino a visitar a un
amigo que vive en la ciudadela.
messages.pt:

messages.en:
{Sound:01:FB}We {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}live in Hyrule Town and other
places, too--not just in these woods.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:FB}Los {Color:Green}minish{Color:White} vivimos en varios sitios,
no sólo en la comunidad del bosque.
messages.pt:
{Sound:01:FB}We {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}live in Hyrule Town and other
places, too--not just in these woods.

{Sound:01:FC}Had you never seen any {Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}before
you came here?
Really? That's so strange.
We Minish live all over the place!

{Sound:01:FC}¿No te has encontrado con ningún
{Color:Green}minish{Color:White} en el camino hacia aquí? 
¿No? Pues qué raro... Con la cantidad

{Sound:02:03}En realidad hay muchos {Color:Green}minish{Color:White} viviendo
en la {Color:Green}ciudadela de Hyrule{Color:White}.

messages.en:
{Sound:02:02}Maybe I should just get out of this
sleepy little town and move to the city.
Or maybe I should go to the mountains.
The folks out there seem to have fun!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:02:02}Creo que abandonaré este lugar
tan aburrido y me iré en busca
de aventuras a la ciudadela... O quizá
a las montañas. Podría ser divertido.
messages.pt:
{Sound:02:02}Maybe I should just get out of this
sleepy little town and move to the city.
Or maybe I should go to the mountains.
The folks out there seem to have fun!

messages.en:
{Sound:01:FB}I received a letter from my friend who
lives in the town library!
I wish I could live in town, too...
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:FB}¡Me ha escrito un amigo que vive en
la biblioteca! Qué envidia... Yo también
quiero vivir en la ciudadela...
messages.pt:
{Sound:01:FB}I received a letter from my friend who
lives in the town library!
I wish I could live in town, too...

messages.en:
{Sound:02:05}Hello!

We're doing cutting-edge research on
Pico Blooms here.
You see that plant with the little bud?
We're working on ways to improve it!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:02:05}¡Hola!

Estoy estudiando las plantas minish.
¿Ves todos esos brotes de plantas?
Los mezclaremos para ver qué ocurre.
messages.pt:
{Sound:02:05}Hello!

We're doing cutting-edge research on
Pico Blooms here.
You see that plant with the little bud?
We're working on ways to improve it!

messages.en:
{Sound:02:02}I need {Color:Red}milk {Color:White}to continue my improvements
on this Pico Bloom.
I wish someone would bring me some.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:02:02}Para crear una nueva planta minish,
es necesaria {Color:Red}leche{Color:White}.
Me vendría tan bien que alguien
me trajese leche...

{Sound:02:02}I need {Color:Red}milk {Color:White}to continue my improvements

I wish someone would bring me some.

messages.en:
{Sound:01:FD}Wow, thanks!
Now I can continue my research!
Come on back when this
flower blossoms!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:FD}¡Qué bien, gracias!
¡Podré continuar mi investigación!
Qué ganas tengo de que crezcan
mis nuevas plantitas... ♪
messages.pt:
{Sound:01:FD}Wow, thanks!
Now I can continue my research!
Come on back when this
flower blossoms!

messages.en:
{Sound:02:02}My new Pico Bloom hasn't blossomed yet.
Come back soon, though.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:02:02}Las nuevas plantitas aún no
han crecido. Espera un poco más.
messages.pt:
{Sound:02:02}My new Pico Bloom hasn't blossomed yet.
Come back soon, though.

messages.en:
{Sound:01:FF}Look! I succeeded in growing a {Color:Blue}Yellow
Pico Bloom{Color:White}! It's all thanks to you!
I'm so grateful for all your help!
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:FF}¡Guau! ¡He conseguido una planta
minish {Color:Blue}amarilla{Color:White}!
¡Todo gracias a ti! Muchas gracias.
messages.pt:
{Sound:01:FF}Look! I succeeded in growing a {Color:Blue}Yellow
Pico Bloom{Color:White}! It's all thanks to you!
I'm so grateful for all your help!

messages.en:
{Sound:01:FC}I am working on my next Pico Bloom
enhancement...
All I need is some {Color:Red}Mt. Crenel Mineral
Water{Color:White} to complete it.
But the mountain is so far away, and I
don't know how to get any.
I wish someone would bring me some.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:01:FC}Quiero hacer otro injerto de planta
minish. Esta vez necesito {Color:Red}agua del
monte Gongol{Color:White}. Con lo lejos que
está... Ojalá me la trajese alguien...

messages.en:
There should be some {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White} living here
in this forest.
Eh? Who are the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}? Ah, yes,
how silly of me!
You humans call them "{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}," but they
refer to themselves as the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}!
Strange how, in the world of humans,
only this forest has kept the name...
Anyhow, deep in the forest they built a
tiny village, where many now live.
But if we're to enter the village, we'll
have to make you a touch smaller first.
Look for a tree stump. Then, I can
shrink you to the size of the "{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}."
messages.es_ref:
Dicen que en este bosque viven
algunos minish.
Parece ser que hay una comunidad de
minish en lo más profundo del bosque.
Para entrar, tendrías que menguar
hasta alcanzar un tamaño diminuto.
Si encuentras el tronco de un árbol
talado, te enseñaré cómo menguar.

messages.en:
{Sound:00:92}{04:10:00}Hold on for a moment, my boy! We've
stumbled across something important!
The world of the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White} is very small.
You're far too big to meet them now.
Eh? Who are the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}? Ah, yes! Silly
me! Allow me to explain...
You humans call them "{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}," but they
refer to themselves as the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}!
Strange how, in the world of humans,
only this forest has kept that name...
Anyhow, deep in the forest they built a
tiny village, where many now live.
But if we're to enter the village, we'll
have to make you a touch smaller first.
Look at that. At first glance, it
appears to be a mere stump, yes?
No! That stump is a {Color:Blue}portal{Color:White} used by
people long ago to adjust their size!
With my help, you can use it to {Color:Blue}shrink
down to Minish size{Color:White}.
Just stand on the stump and press {Key:Right}
to shrink.
To return to normal, stand next to the
stump and press {Key:Right}.
Get me up there, and we'll give
it a try.
messages.es_ref:
{Sound:00:92}{04:10:00}¡Te contaré un secreto!
El mundo de los {Color:Green}minish{Color:White} es diminuto...
Con ese tamaño no podrás conocerlos
nunca. Pero yo sé qué hay que hacer.
Observa con atención.

¿Ves ese tocón? En realidad es una
puerta secreta al mundo de los minish
que crearon los hombres hace muchos
años.
Si me llevas puesto y subes al tocón,
{Color:Blue}menguarás hasta parecer un minish{Color:White}.
Colócate sobre el tocón y pulsa
el Botón {Key:Right} para menguar.
Cuando quieras recuperar tu tamaño,
colócate junto al tocón y pulsa el
Botón {Key:Right}. ¡Inténtalo!

messages.en:
Welcome to the world through the
eyes of the Minish!
Now, aren't you glad you saved me?
No need to thank me, though!
Portals that reduce your size are {Color:Blue}all
around, in different shapes and sizes{Color:White}.{Color:Blue}
{Color:White}If you want to return to normal, stand
next to a portal and press {Key:Right}.
But there is one thing you must know:
{Color:Blue}being Minish-sized is full of dangers{Color:White}!
Mere puddles at your normal size
are bottomless swamps to the Minish.
And as your companion, if anything bad
happens to you, it happens to me, too!
So proceed with caution, my lad! If not
for your sake, then for my own!
messages.es_ref:
¡Éste es el diminuto mundo de los minish!

Seguro que ahora te alegras de
haberme salvado. Fíjate bien, porque
{Color:Blue}hay muchas entradas al mundo
de los minish y todas no son tocones{Color:White}. 
Cuando quieras recuperar tu tamaño,
no tienes más que colocarte junto a
una entrada y pulsar el Botón {Key:Right}.
Eso sí, no olvides que {Color:Blue}cuando
mengües, tendrás que hacer frente a
más peligros de lo normal{Color:White}. Para un ser
diminuto como los minish, una gota de
agua puede ser un problema enorme.
Claro que yo estaré bien atento
también por la cuenta que me trae.
